CreatorContractsSection.glisseLePdfIciOu: Drop the PDF here, or pick it.
CreatorContractsSection.aucunContratDeposePourCe: No contract uploaded for this project.

CreatorDetailView.passeEnActifAutomatiquementDes: Switches to “Active” automatically as soon as one of their accounts is approved.
CreatorDetailView.langueDesEMailsDe: Language of the emails, of their space, and of the “View their space” preview. Once their account exists, their own preference (Profile) wins.
CreatorDetailView.sertDeReferenceAuxDates: The reference for dates: warm-up days, due dates and nudges. A country doesn't determine a time zone — the US has six — so “not set” beats a guess.
CreatorDetailView.aEteDeduitDuPays: was inferred from their accounts' country then
CreatorDetailView.aSonPremierCheckDe: at their first warm-up check: it will no longer follow their accounts' country. Pick a value above to correct it.
CreatorDetailView.estDeduitDuPaysDe: is inferred from their accounts' country. Nothing is stored yet: the value will follow the country, and freeze at their first warm-up check.
CreatorDetailView.corrigeUneInvitationFaiteAvec: Fixes an invite made with the wrong population. Possible while the profile is blank — as soon as an account, a post or a pay line is attached, the population is frozen.
CreatorDetailView.changeraAussiLEspaceAuquel: Will also change the space this person reaches at their next login. Save to apply.
CreatorDetailView.leOuLesQueCe: The handle(s) this creator must create on their networks (shown in “My accounts”, next to the warm-up instructions). Leave a network empty to ask for nothing.
CreatorDetailView.laCleDAttributionDes: The attribution key for visitors and sales. Without it, the creator shows as “no ref set” in the conversion section — in-app TikTok traffic sends no referrer, everything rests on this path.
CreatorDetailView.supprimeDefinitivementCeCreateurSes: Permanently deletes this creator: their accounts and open missions are erased (combos released); their posts and payment history are kept under their name. Irreversible.
CreatorDetailView.expireLeRegenereLeS: Expires on {date}. Regenerate it if it's expired or lost (the old link stops working immediately).
CreatorDetailView.leCreateurAPerduSon: Creator lost their password? Generate a one-time reset link (valid 48h) and send it to them (WhatsApp). You never see their password.
CreatorDetailView.rattacheCeCreateurMemeCompte: Attach this creator (same account, same login) to another of your projects. Their accounts, assignments and earnings stay separate there.
CreatorDetailView.aucunAutreProjetDisponibleDeja: No other project available (already a member of all your projects).
CreatorDetailView.envoieCeLienAuCreateur: Send this link to the creator (WhatsApp). It's valid 48h, one-time: once used, it stops working.
CreatorDetailView.deduitDuPaysAConfirmer: inferred from the country — to confirm
CreatorDetailView.notesInternesNonVisiblesPar: Internal notes (not visible to the creator)…
CreatorDetailView.figeSurChaqueClipAu: Frozen on each clip when it's assigned — changing it doesn't change any clip already ordered.
CreatorDetailView.forfaitMensuelMoisDEntree: Monthly retainer — first and last months paid in full, no proration. Due for every month elapsed whatever the number of takes uploaded; the take count shows next to the amount, in Payments. Changing it doesn't affect any month already paid.
CreatorDetailView.nouveauLienGenereLAncien: New link generated — the old one is disabled

BonusGridSection.lesPaliersDuPricingChoisi: The chosen pricing's tiers unlock on this creator's TOTAL lifetime views. Cash = counted; in-kind = a reward to hand over.
